morgan: PTAL — addressed the feedback from earlier. Removed dead feature flag, added unit + integration tests, updated changelog, rebased onto main, and added a short smoke script for staging.

morgan: Changed files: pkg/flags/feature.go, pkg/flags/feature_test.go, integrations/canary_smoke.sh, docs/changelog.md

morgan: smoke steps (run in staging):
```
./integrations/canary_smoke.sh --env=staging
```

jamie: looking now, thanks. quick q — did you keep the flag default off for Dedicated customers?

morgan: yep default is off. added env var REDWOOD_ENABLE_NEW_CACHE to gate it. unit test covers both on/off flows.

alex: PTAL in a bit, heads down on a perf job. if it's rebased + smoke passes we can schedule canary Fri 09:00 PT. need one more approval from infra.

release-bot: CI: build passed · tests: 82/82 · e2e: 3/3 · coverage 92% · artifacts uploaded

jamie: lgtm after CI green — left two tiny nits inline (var name + comment), not blocking.

morgan: fixed both nits and force-pushed (rebased -> pushed). PTAL again.

alex: approving now. @nia can you give the infra second approval for the Fri 09:00 PT canary slot? :calendar:

nia: sounds good — I can take final approve after canary smoke is green. ping me ~08:30 PT and I'll join the smoke.

morgan: will do. I'll schedule the canary and drop the smoke run link here once started. thanks all :pray:
